articles.t: GTA 6 Is So Big That It's Destroying Your Internet Connection
articles.chapeau: GTA 6’s 212 GB download hit so hard one internet provider slowed down.
articles.txt:
By Jared Solomon Published Nov 13, 2026, 11:30 AM EST Jared has spent 15 years covering the auto industry, getting his first break with autoX—one of Asia’s biggest auto magazines. Since 2010, he has reviewed hundreds of cars and motorbikes around the world, worked with Top Gear, Autocar, Evo, Motoring World, and Quattroruote, served on the IMOTY jury for five years, and is a founding member of the Automotive Journalist Association of India (AJAI).
The first Grand Theft Auto traffic jam happened before anybody could jack a car. No pileup on a Vice City freeway . No genius in a stolen supercar trying to take an exit at 180 mph. Just a lot of people hitting download and at least one internet provider having a very bad day.
GTA 6 Extended Trailer Netflix Gameplay Screenshot Police Chase Netflix / Rockstar Grand Theft Auto 6 launches November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, but the digital preload is already out there taking up to 212 GB, depending on the console. If your storage is packed, get ready to have a brutally honest conversation with the games you swear you’re going to finish someday.
Storage was only the first casualty. In the UK, internet provider YouFibre told customers that demand for GTA 6 downloads had caused a capacity issue on its network and reduced download speeds, according to Forbes. Imagine paying for fast internet, sitting down to watch something, and finding out your connection is stuck behind a convoy of people downloading a game about stealing cars. The kid next door hasn’t even made it out of the loading screen and he’s already a menace to the neighborhood.
GTA 6 kellison j6 Rockstar Games Virgin Media O2 logged its busiest broadband day, blowing past the daily record set by a major Fortnite update. The GTA rush also topped the previous evening peak from an Arsenal Champions League match. If you’re keeping score, that’s one game that nobody could play beating a game people were playing and a match people were actually watching.
Over in Ireland, the Internet Neutral Exchange handled 12.53 petabytes of traffic in a day, up from a six-month daily average of 9.53 petabytes, according to JOE.ie. That’s about 31 percent more data than usual. The exchange also set a peak traffic record and pointed to the GTA preload as the likely reason. There’s something deeply funny about a game famous for letting you ignore traffic laws producing the digital equivalent of everybody trying to merge onto the same highway at once.
GTA VI Cover Rockstar Games The funny part is that the early download was supposed to make launch night smoother. The preload rolled out more than a week ahead of release, giving players time to grab the files and giving networks a chance to spread the load. It’s the internet equivalent of telling everybody to leave early for a race weekend. Great plan until a ridiculous number of people decide that “early” means the exact same hour.
At a steady 50 Mbps, a 212 GB download takes about nine and a half hours in ideal conditions. Drop to 10 Mbps and you’re looking at more than 47 hours. That’s two nights of watching a progress bar inch forward while your group chat asks if you’re ready yet. And if you bought a physical code-in-box edition, you’re in that download line too once you redeem the code. You just got a box to look at while you wait.
There’s a fair question buried in all this. When a single game can put enough strain on a provider’s network to slow down people who never bought it, how much extra capacity should that provider have ready for a launch this big? You can already picture the argument in the comments. Half the room will blame Rockstar for the monster file. The other half will ask why their fiber connection tapped out before the game even unlocked.
Come November 19, the first thing plenty of car people will do is find something quick, crank the radio and see how long they can keep it out of a guardrail. Until then, the only thing some of us are redlining is the router.
Preload size and release timing are from VGC and AP. The reported traffic figures and slowdown are from JOE.ie, Moneycontrol and Forbes. Download times are calculated at steady speeds.

Shrek 2 Remastered : Aspyr explique pourquoi sortir près de GTA 6 n'est pas un risque
articles.txt:
Alors que de nombreux éditeurs ont choisi d’éviter novembre 2026 pour ne pas affronter Grand Theft Auto 6 , Aspyr assume pleinement la sortie de Shrek 2 Remastered quelques jours seulement avant le mastodonte de Rockstar. Le studio a expliqué pourquoi il ne considère pas ce calendrier comme un risque, mais au contraire comme une opportunité.
La sortie de GTA 6 , prévue en novembre 2026, a poussé de nombreux développeurs et éditeurs à revoir leurs plans. Certains ont avancé leurs jeux en septembre ou octobre, d’autres ont préféré repousser à 2027. Mais Aspyr, qui publie Shrek 2 Remastered sur Nintendo Switch et Switch 2 , a choisi de maintenir sa date, quelques jours avant le lancement du titre de Rockstar.
Interrogé sur cette décision, le studio a répondu sans détour : « Est-ce que d’autres jeux sortent ce mois-ci ? En toute sincérité, nous ne voyons pas cela comme une compétition frontale. Shrek 2 est un jeu coopératif léger que l’on peut apprécier entre amis ou en famille, et beaucoup de joueurs prendront plaisir à jouer aux deux. »
Aspyr met en avant la nature même de Shrek 2 Remastered pour justifier ce choix. Contrairement à GTA 6, qui vise un public adulte et une expérience solo massive, le jeu basé sur l’univers de DreamWorks se veut accessible et convivial. « Les fêtes sont le moment où les gens se retrouvent autour du canapé ou se connectent en ligne ensemble. Pour un jeu comme celui-ci, novembre est le bon moment, pas un moment à éviter », explique le studio.
Cette logique s’appuie sur une réalité du marché : les jeux familiaux et coopératifs connaissent souvent un pic de ventes pendant les vacances de fin d’année. Les joueurs cherchent des titres à partager, et Shrek 2 Remastered correspond parfaitement à ce créneau. De plus, la sortie simultanée sur Switch et Switch 2 élargit considérablement la base de joueurs potentiels, la Switch originale restant très répandue.
Autre particularité de cette sortie : la courte fenêtre entre l’annonce et la disponibilité du jeu. Aspyr a choisi de ne pas faire durer l’attente. « Nous voulions annoncer le jeu quand il était prêt, pour ne pas faire patienter les fans », précise le studio. Cette stratégie, de plus en plus courante dans l’industrie, permet de capitaliser sur l’enthousiasme immédiat et d’éviter les retards éventuels.
Elle contraste avec les longues campagnes marketing de certains blockbusters, mais elle est cohérente avec la nature du produit : un remaster d’un jeu apprécié, qui n’a pas besoin de plusieurs mois de teasing pour exister. Les fans de la première heure savent déjà à quoi s’attendre, et les nouveaux joueurs peuvent être séduits par la promesse d’une expérience coopérative immédiate.
La sortie de GTA 6 a créé une onde de choc dans l’industrie. Même des titres très attendus comme The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (remake sur Switch 2) ont été positionnés stratégiquement. Take-Two, l’éditeur de GTA 6, a d’ailleurs commenté la proximité de ces deux sorties. Le PDG Strauss Zelnick a qualifié le jeu de Nintendo de « formidable », ajoutant que ses créateurs « devraient être très fiers de ce titre ».
Dans ce paysage, Aspyr joue une carte différente : plutôt que de lutter frontalement, le studio mise sur la complémentarité. Les joueurs peuvent très bien acheter GTA 6 pour leurs sessions solo et Shrek 2 Remastered pour jouer avec leurs proches. Les budgets et les attentes ne sont pas les mêmes, et les deux jeux peuvent coexister sans se cannibaliser.
Shrek 2 Remastered n’est pas un simple portage. Aspyr a travaillé sur une version modernisée du jeu sorti initialement en 2004, avec des graphismes améliorés et des ajustements pour les consoles actuelles. Le jeu propose une aventure coopérative jusqu’à quatre joueurs, reprenant l’histoire du film avec humour et action. C’est un titre parfait pour les soirées en famille ou entre amis, ce qui renforce l’argument de la période des fêtes.
La disponibilité sur Switch et Switch 2 est également un point fort. La Switch 2, sortie en 2025, bénéficie d’une base installée croissante, tandis que la Switch originale reste l’une des consoles les plus vendues de l’histoire. En couvrant les deux plateformes, Aspyr s’assure une large audience potentielle.
En fin de compte, la décision d’Aspyr de sortir Shrek 2 Remastered à quelques jours de GTA 6 est un pari calculé. Le studio ne cherche pas à rivaliser avec le géant de Rockstar, mais à occuper un créneau distinct : celui du jeu familial et coopératif pendant les fêtes. Si l

articles.t: GTA 6 Preorder Sales Suggest a Record Nobody Can Touch
articles.chapeau: It’s already one of the year’s best-selling games and it isn’t even out yet
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is out next week on Nov. 19. It'll only be available digitally , but that hasn't stopped people from preordering. In fact, they've been preordering Rockstar's next open-world adventure in record numbers. New preorder sales estimates peg GTA 6 as having already made over $1 billion in revenue.
According to market analysis firm Sensor Tower , GTA 6 has already sold an estimated 12.13 million copies. Those sales have generated an estimated $1.18 billion in revenue. That makes the average price of each sale about $97, meaning the majority of players are opting for the more expensive Ultimate Edition ($99.99) rather than the standard edition ($79.99). All these preorders have made GTA 6 the most-preordered game for both the PlayStation and Xbox stores . Earlier this month, estimates put GTA 6 at just under 8 million copies sold and $751 million in revenue, meaning its sales spiked in a very short amount of time.
Sensor Tower's estimates show a pretty wide split between PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X copies sold. PS5 copies account for about 75% of the estimated sales, or 9.08 million copies and $880 million in revenue. That's not surprising as the PlayStation 5 has outsold the Xbox Series X and S this generation, and PlayStation has been marketing GTA 6 hard. It will even have exclusive PS5 Pro features .
Image: Rockstar Games All the attention on GTA 6 's launch has hurt other sales across the entire industry. That includes Rockstar's parent company Take-Two's other fall tentpole release, NBA 2K27 , which failed to meet expectations. The basketball sim is still one of the top-performing games of the year .
Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on Thursday, Nov. 19. It will have a rolling midnight launch on PS5 and will be playable starting at 1 a.m. EST on Xbox Series X.

articles.t: GTA 6 has its own animated series
articles.chapeau: Rockstar has made an animated show that players can watch in-game. It could be a fun way to spend some downtime after a story mission, as it will presumably be available to watch on the TV in your in-game apartment.
articles.txt:
GTA V and GTA Online allow players to watch movies within the game as one of the many activities. There are three movies that screen throughout the day, and players can go to a theatre to catch a show. That trend will likely continue with GTA 6 as Rockstar has apparently added an animated TV series that players can watch within the game.
‘Macca and Friends’ is the name of the animated series that, according to DiscussingFilm on X, follows the adventures of Macca the Gator and his friends, set within Leonida. The series will be available on the WEAZEL TV channel, so players should be able to watch it in their in-game apartments. Presumably, it will be available anywhere there is a TV screen that can be interacted with.
The short trailer shows Macca, his crab friend Pinche – who reminds us of Sebastian from The Little Mermaid – and a few other wetland friends, along with a human police officer. It will be available from day one in-game. It is unclear what the scope of this in-game show is, or if Rockstar has any plans of bringing the show independently to other streaming platforms.
GTA 6 is less than a week away, and it’s already made over $1 billion in pre-orders . A recent report suggested that the new GTA Online will release about a year later , so late 2027. That’s later than previous estimates, and it is unclear if a PC release will happen before that or be pushed to 2028.

articles.t: The GTA 5 Bucket List – 15 Things to Do Before GTA 6
articles.chapeau: From underground car meets and stealing prized fighter jets, to cryptid encounters and landing aeroplanes in silly places, GTA 5 has proven itself as an eternal playground.
articles.txt:
W e’re finally in Grand Theft Auto VI ’s launch month, and for many of you that means it’ll soon be time to leave GTA 5 – at least for now – to spend time in Leonida’s open world. To say San Andreas and Blaine County are anything less than iconic is an understatement, and while GTA 5 and GTA Online won’t suddenly become unavailable once GTA 6 releases, you might feel the urge to tick off any outstanding activities before saying goodbye. So, with that in mind, we’ve put a list of diversions together – some are pragmatic, others absurd, but all are worthy of your time. Here’s fifteen final things to do in GTA 5 before you play GTA 6 .
The oldest dogfighting jet in the game is a breeze to pilot, and it’s still hella fun to freeroam sorties over Los Santos in GTA Online . Surely everyone has stolen the P-996 LAZER from Fort Zanduco already, but if you haven’t you’re missing out on a right of passage. There’s a handful of ways to sneak into the heavily guarded base, some leaning on save scumming to keep the heat off and others embracing the chaos of law enforcement. Either way, you simply must steal this plane at least once. It might not be the best in the game anymore, but it’ll always feel like a mark unchecked until it’s in your hangar.
Yeah, go for 100% completion, because why not? Well, beyond story missions, random events, hobbies, and collect-a-thons, the Strangers and Freaks side missions are the most humorous and memorable activities in the entire game. Yeah, they can be lucrative too, but they often exaggerate GTA ’s long-history of satirical humour and absurdity while still contributing to the tangibility of GTA 5 ’s world. But, that said, achieving ‘career criminal’ status, shaping the landscape to your whim, is absolutely worth doing before moving on to Leonida.
Through countless hours of nefarious activity and chaotic stunt driving, you’d be forgiven for forgetting just how interesting the state of San Andreas and Blaine County actually are. Los Santos is, of course, GTA 5 ’s stand-in for LA, and if you were a tourist here what would you do? You could ride a bike from Vespucci Beach to Del Pierro pier, perhaps enjoying the pier’s attractions when you’re there. Take a cab to Vinewood, hike up to Galileo Observatory, watch the sunset over downtown. There’s a slice of life the campaign doesn’t focus on; soak it in.
This one’s kinda like a tourist thing, but more thrill-seeking. Between flying fighter jets and jumping out of airplanes, there’s a distinct thrill in careening down Mount Chiliad on the saddle of a pushbike. Will I spill before I get to the bottom? Or, can I smoothly cut through the canyons and trees to land in Paleto Bay? There’s no tangible reward for this; it’s just fun, and something probably everyone has attempted at some point. Still, get up there, ride down.
Look – we know you’ve likely already done everything on this feature. Escaping a 5-star wanted level isn’t exactly the most taxing activity either, what with underground tunnels, Los Santos Customs paintjobs, and thundering aircraft capable of outrunning LAPD choppers with ease. But, GTA 6 is re-introducing six stars, and with Leonida’s slew of waterways and open roads, who knows what topographical or vehicular advantages you’ll find. So, one final time, why not shake the tail of a 5-star chase.
If you’re replaying the campaign, you should save Lester’s assassination missions until you’ve completed the final heist. Why? Because you’ll be loaded, of course. See, Lester chooses targets for you based on how their untimely death will rock the online markets, and how you can invest in the right LCN and BAWSAQ stocks to skyrocket your own wealth. Well, at the end of the game you’ll be as rich as you’ll ever be, so it makes sense to save these assassination missions until then. All told, you can net $2 billion per protagonist, meaning you can buy Los Santos Golf Club with life-changing money still in your account.
GTA 5 has many stand-out missions, and if you’ve only been through the campaign once or twice it’d be remiss not to experience your favourites again. But what are the best missions? Well, the Paleto Bay bank heist, Trevor’s crop duster acrobatics over the Alamo Sea, the Grove Street turf war, or Michael and Trevor’s joint shoot-and-chase of the downed private jet spring to mind, but you, of course, will have your favourites too.

GTA 6 map accidentally leaks days before historic release
articles.chapeau: As the GTA VI map leaks ahead of November 19, angry collectors are disappointed that physical copies don't include a poster showing off the new Vice City.
articles.txt:
This article contains paid shopping links. LADbible Group receives a small payment if you click on these links or make a purchase through them.
We honestly worried this day might never come, but teaching us that patience is a virtue, Grand Theft Auto VI is nearly upon us. Having been shunted from an originally proposed release date of fall 2025, we were then struck by another delay that pushed it back from May 2026, but at least we'll be able to play in time for Christmas.
With a long-awaited return to Vice City , we'll be able to visit this neon-splashed locale with a fresh set of eyes.
Vice City was where we called home in 2002's fan-favorite GTA: Vice City , but as that game was set in1986 and GTA VI is set in modern times, a lot has likely changed in the past 40 years.
We're expecting plenty of nods to Tommy Vercetti , but as voice actor Ray Liotta sadly passed away in 2022, don't expect the man himself to cross paths with Jason and Lucia . Still, GTA fans are pumped about the potential to revisit Tommy's old stomping grounds like the Ocean View Hotel and the Malibu Club. Just days ahead of GTA VI' s November 19 release , the game's colossal map has leaked.
Selfridges has been celebrating GTA VI in style, releasing its own collection of unique merchandise that's already turning into a scalpers' dream. Even if we're not sold on spending $3,355 on a jacket, the fact that the collection sold out in a matter of hours is a testament to how popular the game is.
As shared on X, a GTA VI Collector's Set on display at Selfridges in the United Kingdom includes what appears to be the official map folded up inside the display. While the original Instagram account has since been deleted, other images showing the full GTA VI map are spreading like wildfire.
It's alleged that a Collector's Box was on sale at a specific branch of Selfridges in Manchester and has since been sold, but with an unfurled version being shared on X, locations including Goose Key, Lummox County, and Moreau are visible.
Notably, Rockstar is living up to its promise that we'll be exploring far more than just the central hub of Vice City.
Coming in at $399.99 (without an actual copy of the game), Rockstar’s description of the Collector's Box lists a “Double-Sided Souvenir Poster with Map of Leonida."
Over on Reddit, some speculated that Rockstar had been holding back revealing the full map to save story spoilers. Redditor u/PenseeG mused: "I believe the reason the physical version didn’t come with a map is less about greed and more about spoilers. I think they’re hiding something on the final map that they want us to discover organically on the 19th."
Some held out hope that the map would confirm the idea of multiple cities or a potential DLC expansion with a whole new region to explore, but from what we can see, there aren't many spoilers here.
You might remember the whole fracas involving GTA VI's physical copies , namely because you don't get an actual disc. It seems Rockstar Games already had the inside track on PlayStation's plans to axe physical gaming discs in January 2028 , announcing that while you still get a box for GTA VI , there's just a download code inside.
This has led to a fierce debate about the death of physical media and future-proofing our gaming collection, but at least you still get a vibrant GTA VI poster to stick on your walls.
Casting your minds back, everything from Skyrim to Cyberpunk 2077 included map posters so you could retrace your steps. Even though the GTA series has become synonymous with double-sided posters that include a map, Rockstar is feeling the wrath of angry collectors who are missing out with GTA VI .
Over on X, one disgruntled gamer complained: "I genuinely hope everyone who bought the "physical" version feels like they were scammed because they deserve to feel like that after pre-ordering an empty box with a poster and a download code, when other Rockstar releases included the game physically on disc and a fold out map."
Another grumbled: "A free double-sided poster with the physical GTA 6 copy and people still say digital is better. I want the box, the poster, the whole ritual."
A third said: "If that's what's considered a physical copy then I am the Pope."

articles.t: Pas besoin de PS5 ou de Xbox Series pour jouer à GTA 6 : cette vieille console à 65 euros suffit
articles.chapeau: Oui, il est possible de jouer à GTA 6 sur une vieille console d'occasion vendue moins de 70 euros, sans machine récente. Mais cette astuce repose sur le cloud gaming et comporte quelques contraintes à connaître.
articles.txt:
Maurine Briantais 13 novembre 2026 17:00 Oui, il est possible de jouer à GTA 6 sur une vieille console d'occasion vendue moins de 70 euros, sans machine récente. Mais cette astuce repose sur le cloud gaming et comporte quelques contraintes à connaître.
Ça y est, l'attente des joueurs va enfin être récompensée ! Alors que cela fait des années que les fans de Grand Theft Auto – GTA pour les intimes – s'impatientent, rêvant de se plonger dans le sixième opus de cette licence emblématique, ils vont enfin pouvoir mettre les mains sur le précieux.
Certains ont même acheté une PS5 ou une Xbox Series spécialement pour l'occasion ! Cependant, avec les hausses de prix successives , se procurer une console de dernière génération n'est pas à la portée de n'importe quelle bourse.
Heureusement, il n'est pas nécessaire de débourser plusieurs centaines d'euros pour pouvoir profiter de GTA 6 . En effet, il suffit en réalité de se procurer une ancienne Xbox One d'occasion et de jouer dessus en cloud gaming. Une opération qui peut revenir à 65 euros seulement…
Même si cela parait trop beau pour être vrai, Rockstar Games a bel et bien confirmé que GTA 6 serait accessible sur Xbox One. Ce ne sera toutefois pas grâce à la puissance, aujourd'hui totalement obsolète, de la console, mais au Xbox Cloud Gaming, le service de streaming de Microsoft. Il ne sera donc pas nécessaire de posséder une PS5, une Xbox Series X ou S pour découvrir le prochain épisode de la célèbre franchise.
Alors qu'une Xbox Serie neuve coûte entre 500 et 800 euros, selon le modèle, tandis qu'une PS5 est généralement vendue entre 600 et 650 euros – et même 900 euros pour une PS5 Pro –, il est aujourd'hui possible de se procurer une Xbox One d'occasion pour seulement 65 euros chez Micromania , manette comprise, en optant pour un modèle avec 500 Go. On peut bien évidemment trouver d'autres offres sur d'autres plateformes, généralement sous les 100 euros.
Il faut cependant bien garder en tête que ce n'est pas la console elle-même qui fera tourner le jeu. Elle servira simplement à afficher les images et à transmettre les commandes du joueur. C'est un serveur distant, hébergé par Microsoft , qui exécutera le jeu et effectuera tous les calculs nécessaires. Une façon de contourner les limitations matérielles d'une console vieille de treize ans, à condition de disposer d'une connexion Internet suffisamment rapide et stable – faute de câble, Microsoft conseille un Wi-Fi en 5 GHz ou 6 GHz.
En jouant en cloud gaming sur Xbox One, GTA 6 sera affiché avec les réglages graphiques de la Xbox Series S lorsqu'il sera diffusé en streaming. Il ne faut donc pas s'attendre exactement au même rendu que sur une Xbox Series X. La qualité de l'affichage dépendra également de la connexion Internet et de la stabilité du réseau. En effet, avec une connexion instable ou un débit insuffisant, les images risquent de perdre en netteté, de se figer ou de présenter un décalage avec les commandes. Un problème particulièrement gênant dans un jeu où la réactivité est importante.
Jouer en cloud gaming ne dispense pas d' acheter le jeu , car il n'est pas compris dans le Xbox Game Pass. L'édition Standard est affichée à 79,99 euros, tandis que l'édition Ultimate de GTA 6 est vendue 99,99 euros sur le Microsoft Store.
En plus du jeu et de la Xbox One, il faudra disposer d'un accès au Xbox Cloud Gaming. Et justement, Microsoft a modifié les conditions d'accès à son service en novembre 2026. Les abonnements Game Pass comprennent désormais un quota mensuel de temps de jeu dans le cloud :
Attention, même en souscrivant à la formule Ultimate, les 15 heures mensuelles risquent de ne pas suffire pour profiter pleinement de GTA 6 . Une fois ce crédit épuisé, il faudra donc acheter des heures supplémentaires pour continuer à jouer en streaming. Il est également possible d'acheter directement du temps de jeu dans le cloud sans souscrire au Game Pass, dans les pays où cette option est proposée – ils sont testés par les membres du programme Xbox Insider à partir de 3,99 $ les 10 heures, mais leur prix en euros n'est pas encore connu. Il faut donc bien distinguer le prix du jeu, celui de la console et celui de l'accès au streaming.
Sur le papier, l'idée est séduisante. Plutôt que de débourser plusieurs centaines d'euros dans une Xbox Series X ou S, il devient possible de jouer à l'un des jeux les plus attendus de l'année avec une console d'occasion vendue pour moins de 100 euros. Il faut cependant garder en tête les frais

articles.t: PSA: GTA 6 Does Not Have Online Multiplayer at Launch
articles.chapeau: It
articles.txt:
GTA 6 is now less than a week away from its official launch, coming to PS5 on 19th November, 2026.
It's likely to become the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with excitement at a fever pitch coming off the back of GTA 5 , which is the third best-selling game ever at a staggering 235 million copies .
Something that not everyone may know, however, is that GTA 6 will be a single-player game only at first; the online component will not be available initially.
This won't come as a shock to those in the know, as Rockstar Games has described it as a solo experience and has not yet referred to any form of online play.
However, it seems there are many expectant fans that are excited to hop straight into multiplayer with their buddies. In case you didn't know, you won't be able to do this when GTA 6 launches next week.
I suspect this confusion comes from just how long GTA 5 has been around. The game was first released on PS3 13 years ago, and GTA Online is almost as old, launching a couple of weeks after the main game.
Re-releases of GTA 5 on PS4 and PS5 have always arrived with GTA Online as part of the package, so even though the original game didn't have online multiplayer to begin with, it's been a constant presence for millions of players for well over a decade.
It makes sense that people have become accustomed to GTA 5 providing GTA Online, and took it for granted that its sequel would include the feature from day one. This is not the case.
For GTA 6, it's expected that an updated version of GTA Online will launch sometime in 2027, though an exact date has yet to be confirmed. It won't take a full year to appear, despite what this recent Bloomberg video inadvertently suggests.
It's believed that GTA Online will come to GTA 6 in a matter of a few months, possibly launching in the first quarter of 2027.
Rumour has it that the PC port of GTA 6 will launch in a similar timeframe, and it would make sense for these two things to be aligned.
So, to summarise: GTA 6 does not feature online multiplayer at launch, but it likely won't be too far off.

articles.t: Take-Two Boss Talks About Physical Games and Gives Hope to GTA 6 Fans Who Want a Disc Version of the Most Anticipated Game in History | LEVEL UP

CEO Strauss Zelnick likened the future of physical games to vinyl records in music, suggesting they will remain but as a small part of the market. articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI is finally a reality, and in just a few days, everyone will be able to explore Vice City to their heart’s content. While this is certainly an exciting moment, the absence of a traditional physical release is hard to ignore, and many fans believe disc-based games are living on borrowed time.
The head of Take-Two Interactive discussed the possible disappearance of physical formats in the video game industry and confirmed what we already knew: these releases represent only a very small portion of the market. However, he also offered some hope to those who want a physical release of the highly anticipated GTA 6 .
Earlier this year, Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar Games finally launched preorders for Grand Theft Auto 6 , revealing several details about the game, from the contents of its deluxe edition to its official price. The companies also confirmed some disappointing news: the game will not have a physical edition .
Although retailers will sell GTA 6 boxes, these cases will be empty and won’t include a disc. Instead, they will contain a simple download code that allows players to redeem the game through the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store, depending on their platform.
Given that we’re talking about one of the most important and influential video games in history, many believe the absence of a traditional physical release marks the definitive end of disc-based games. Strauss Zelnick, CEO of Take-Two Interactive, is less pessimistic about the situation.
In an interview with The Game Business , the executive was asked whether the company plans to abandon physical formats. It’s a reasonable question, especially considering that, according to the latest official figures, approximately 98% of Take-Two Interactive’s business is already digital.
Surprisingly, Strauss Zelnick believes that although digital games are a cornerstone of the industry, physical formats will not disappear completely. However, he acknowledges that these releases will represent a minority of the business, comparing them to vinyl records in the music industry.
“Perhaps it’s not the end. But listen: we’ve been talking about this for a long time. I predicted that digital distribution would account for more than 90% of the business over 10 years ago. I’m not always right, but I was this time. Will there still be a physical market? Yes, just as there are still vinyl records in music. But it will be a very small part of the business.”
After it became known that GTA 6 would not have a conventional physical edition, many people began to believe this was a strategy to prevent leaks. Rumors even emerged claiming that retailers would finally receive copies of the game on disc a couple of weeks after launch.
However, these rumors were never confirmed, and everything suggests that the company has no interest in releasing a traditional physical version of its open-world game. When the subject came up during another interview with Variety , Strauss Zelnick simply said that Rockstar Games would be responsible for making any announcement on the matter.
The Recording Industry Association of America reported that just over 10% of the music market’s total revenue during the first half of 2026 came from physical formats. This amounted to approximately $581 million, with vinyl records accounting for roughly 80% of those sales.
A similar situation can be seen in the video game industry. Circana revealed that physical game sales reached their lowest point in 30 years during 2025, generating just $1.5 billion. With this figure in mind, it’s easy to understand why PlayStation wants to move away from disc-based releases.
Although the game will be 100% digital, Rockstar Games will release a collection of vinyl records and CDs featuring the original soundtrack from the franchise’s latest installment.
But tell us: Would you buy a physical edition of GTA 6 ? Let us know in the comments.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' physical copies have left fans "pretty disappointed"
articles.chapeau: No disc but there is a giant poster and a download code
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 fans who pre-ordered the physical version of the game have started to receive their copies in the mail – and many have been left disappointed.
Grand Theft Auto 6 officially launches next week (November 19) and fans have been able to pre-load the game since Tuesday (November 10) so they can dive into Vice City as soon as the game goes live.
While Rockstar Games aren’t making any physical discs for Grand Theft Auto 6 , fans have been able to pre-order physical boxes that contain a download code – and they’ve started to be delivered.
Some fans were excited about the new screenshots on the back of the physical box but others aren’t impressed that the only other thing inside the physical edition of Grand Theft Auto 6 is a double-sided poster. The freebie features the game’s artwork but, unlike previous editions of GTA , there is no version of the map.
“No map is actually pretty disappointing,” wrote one Reddit user. “What is even the point of physical editions if we don’t even get maps? Will they add maps to editions sent out after launch,” said another. “It’s fucking crazy how we don’t get much now. I loved going through the maps and instruction booklets that games used to have,” added a third. “Yeah I regret buying the ‘physical’ edition,” wrote another fan.
Sure, we aren't getting a disc for GTA 6, but at least Rockstar Games made sure to pack the physical box with various artworks and screenshots. This is going to feel so nostalgic 10 years from now.
Grand Theft Auto VI ‘Code in a box’ has finally been unboxed by an actual customer. As per reported already, it includes a double sided poster
I wish the GTA 6 box had the map like 5 did but this dual-sided poster is sick pic.twitter.com/PMW3BTMOxn
Rockstar’s decision to not give Grand Theft Auto 6 a full physical release has been met with backlash from fans with some game stores even boycotting the release .
However there are plenty of ways to give Rockstar Games your money. They’ve launched a premium Grand Theft Auto 6: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection which features “all the essentials for a good time” but doesn’t include a copy of the game, while a number of vinyl variants of ‘Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album’ are available to pre-order . A Grand Theft Auto 6 X Selfridges merch pop-up also opened in central London earlier this week.
Hundreds of independent record stores are set to host early listening parties for ‘Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album’ next Wednesday ahead of the album’s full release on November 19.

New GTA 6 'MACCA & FRIENDS' In-Game Trailer Revealed
articles.chapeau: A new trailer has been revealed for MACCA & FRIENDS, an in-game animated show set to feature in Grand Theft Auto 6.
articles.txt:
Marketing for Grand Theft Auto 6 has been ramping up significantly, and with less than a week to go until launch, Rockstar Games is beginning to unveil some of the more unique aspects of the game. Now, a trailer for an in-game animated TV show has been revealed, giving you a glimpse of the entertainment awaiting you in Leonida.
Titled ‘MACCA & FRIENDS,’ the series follows Macca the Gator and his wetland pals as they get into all sorts of mischief across the state of Leonida. Even better, you won’t need to leave GTA 6 to catch an episode, as the entire show will be available to watch in-game.
Revealed exclusively by DiscussingFilm , a popular film and television-focused social media account, the first trailer for GTA 6’s in-game animated series, MACCA & FRIENDS, has officially arrived.
Although the trailer is only 30 seconds long, it introduces several of Macca’s companions, including a sunglasses-wearing talking Sun and Pinchy, a crab who happens to be a landlord. The plot itself is yet to be entirely revealed, but the brief glimpse certainly suggests that Rockstar is going for an aptly comedic approach.
Exclusive first look at ‘MACCA & FRIENDS’. The series follows the adventures of Macca the Gator and his wetland friends across the state of Leonida. Coming November 19 on WEAZEL. pic.twitter.com/yLpn1i3ihX
The reveal is particularly entertaining, as Rockstar’s treating MACCA & FRIENDS like a genuine television series. The show is set to arrive exclusively on WEAZEL on November 19, which, of course, is the fictional TV network within GTA 6. You’ll be able to enjoy a range of unique programming without ever having to leave the game, further exaggerating how you can truly live a life inside GTA 6 .
If you’ve played previous entries in the franchise, the concept of in-game television won’t be entirely new. However, Rockstar giving an original animated series this much attention in its marketing campaign is certainly notable. With Macca and co appearing prominently on physical Leonida maps and the Collector’s Box , it seems the characters are being positioned as some of GTA 6’s colourful mascots.
Rockstar hasn’t exactly been holding back when it comes to GTA 6’s marketing campaign, either. The MACCA & FRIENDS reveal is relatively modest compared to some of the more elaborate promotional efforts, including the ‘Welcome to Vice City’ sign appearing in Miami, the Miami Heat basketball team being transformed into Vice City-themed branding, and even a live festival featuring artists from the game’s soundtrack .
Will you be watching MACCA & FRIENDS? Let us know your thoughts on the Insider Gaming Discord server .

articles.t: Creator of One of Steam’s Most Successful Games Surrenders to GTA 6 and Will Give Employees 5 Days Off to Play the Sandbox | LEVEL UP
articles.chapeau: The development studio says the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 is a “historic occasion”
articles.txt:
Few video games have the media impact of Grand Theft Auto VI , which is shaping up to be one of the biggest releases of all time. The action game has also caught the attention of developers across the industry, who are eager to experience the story of Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval.
With this in mind, the community praised the thoughtful gesture from the studio behind one of the most successful games in Steam history. The company decided to offer its employees up to 5 days off so they can enjoy Rockstar Games’ sandbox without any worries.
The open-world game will debut on November 19, 2026, and nothing or no one will stop it from arriving in stores on its scheduled release date. Many people have already made the necessary preparations and requested time off from work to take part in the launch, while others will conveniently call in sick that day.
Fortunately, some companies have taken the initiative and decided to give their employees time off so they can play GTA 6 during its official launch. One of them is Pocketpair, the studio responsible for one of the most successful games of the last decade: Palworld , which attracted more than 2 million concurrent players on Steam in early 2024.
The open-world title, previously known as “Pokémon with guns,” remains very popular and maintains a highly active player base. That’s why its developers are still working on new updates and DLC, as well as other related projects.
However, for this special occasion, employees at the Japanese studio will be allowed to take time off work and join the millions of players planning to play Grand Theft Auto 6 toward the end of next week.
In a statement shared on social media, Pocketpair announced that it will offer 5 days of vacation to every employee who wants to try Rockstar Games’ title. The company described the game’s launch as a “historic occasion” and believes its employees deserve the chance to be part of it.
“On November 19, millions of players around the world will be sitting at school or work, gazing wistfully out the window, knowing that a new era of gaming is about to begin. At Pocketpair, we believe a historic occasion deserves our full attention,” the announcement reads.
“All employees who intend to play Grand Theft Auto VI 6 will be exempt from their usual duties and are encouraged to take a business trip to Vice City,” the company said in its official statement.
Pocketpair’s vacation period will run from November 19 to November 23, 2026, covering an entire weekend. And yes, the company wanted to avoid any controversy, confirming that development of upcoming updates for Palworld and Craftopia will continue “as scheduled.” This means the time off will not affect production of new content.
This case demonstrates the enormous excitement surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 , which only games such as Monster Hunter and Dragon Quest can match. And yes, the company behind Palworld isn’t the only one giving its employees time off to mark the release of Take-Two Interactive’s title.
Hanneke Faber, Logitech’s CEO, announced that work would be suspended on November 19, meaning most of the company’s employees will have the day off to play GTA 6 or another video game of their choice.
Similarly, California-based automotive parts manufacturer Burger Motorsports said in a social media statement that it would close its doors during the launch of Rockstar Games’ project. Additionally, a report revealed that Grand Theft Auto 6 caused a 17% increase in vacation requests.
Many people have requested time off from school or work so they can play the new GTA .
But tell us: Are you planning to skip work or school? Let us know in the comments.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Rockstar Games dévoile Macca et Friends, une série animée déjantée au cœur de Leonida
articles.txt:
GTA 6 : Rockstar Games dévoile Macca et Friends, une série animée déjantée au cœur de Leonida 13-11-2026 16:20 DL GAMING
Rockstar Games continue de dévoiler les différentes facettes de l'univers de Grand Theft Auto VI. Le studio vient de publier une bande-annonce teaser de Macca & Friends, une série animée fictive intégrée directement au monde du prochain opus. Au programme : les aventures de Macca the Gator et de ses compagnons dans les zones humides de Leonida, l'État fictif qui accueillera les événements de GTA 6.
Macca & Friends : une série animée au cœur de l'univers de GTA 6
L'univers de Grand Theft Auto a toujours accordé une place importante aux médias fictifs qui donnent de la personnalité à ses environnements. Entre les émissions de télévision, les publicités décalées et les programmes radiophoniques, Rockstar Games utilise régulièrement ces éléments pour enrichir la vie quotidienne de ses mondes ouverts.
Avec Macca & Friends, le studio poursuit cette approche en introduisant une nouvelle série animée dans l'univers de GTA 6.
La bande-annonce dévoilée présente Macca the Gator et ses amis des marécages, dont les aventures se déroulent à travers l'État de Leonida. Le concept repose ainsi sur une production animée intégrée à l'environnement du jeu, permettant de découvrir une autre facette de la culture populaire fictive de cette région.
Cette nouvelle création s'inscrit dans la tradition de Rockstar, qui aime multiplier les références culturelles et les contenus secondaires pour rendre ses univers particulièrement vivants.
Dans Grand Theft Auto VI, Leonida constitue le décor principal de l'aventure. Inspiré de la Floride, cet État fictif accueille notamment Vice City, métropole emblématique de la franchise.
Les marécages et leurs habitants font partie des environnements qui contribuent à façonner l'identité de cette région. En choisissant d'y situer Macca & Friends, Rockstar Games met également en avant les aspects les plus insolites de son univers.
La série animée devrait ainsi participer à la construction de cette identité locale, en ajoutant une nouvelle couche de divertissement fictif au monde que les joueurs pourront explorer.
Au-delà de son format humoristique et de ses personnages animés, cette initiative rappelle que GTA 6 ne se limitera pas à son intrigue principale. Comme dans les précédents épisodes, les activités, les médias et les productions présentes dans le jeu auront un rôle important dans la sensation d'immersion.
Cette présentation de Macca & Friends intervient alors que l'attente autour de Grand Theft Auto VI continue de grandir. Le prochain épisode de la franchise est officiellement attendu le 19 novembre 2026 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S.
Rockstar Games poursuit progressivement la présentation de son univers, en dévoilant des éléments qui permettent d'en découvrir les différentes composantes avant le lancement.
Avec Macca & Friends, le studio offre un nouvel aperçu de la créativité déployée autour de Leonida et de ses habitants. Une petite production animée qui contribue à rappeler que, dans GTA, même les divertissements fictifs font partie intégrante de l'expérience.

articles.t: Shrek 2 Remastered dev on releasing at the same time as GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Aspyr has weighed in on releasing Shrek 2 Remastered just days before the behemoth that is Grand Theft Auto 6. Much has been made about games that are taking the risk to come out in November. Many developers and publishers opted to either bring out their titles in September or October, or push to 2027 in order to avoid GTA...
articles.txt:
Aspyr has weighed in on releasing Shrek 2 Remastered just days before the behemoth that is Grand Theft Auto 6.
Much has been made about games that are taking the risk to come out in November. Many developers and publishers opted to either bring out their titles in September or October, or push to 2027 in order to avoid GTA 6. Unless you have something like Zelda: Ocarina of Time – which is able to stand on its own – some view a November launch as a bit of a risk.
We recently asked Aspyr about Shrek 2 Remastered launching in November as well as the short announcement to release strategy. The company doesn’t actually view it as a competition. That’s because Shrek is very different – the remaster is “a lighthearted co-op game you can pick up with friends and family, and plenty of players will happily play both.”
How about this month specifically? Aspyr said “November is the right moment, not one to avoid,” especially given the holiday season.
“Are other games coming out this month? In all seriousness, we don’t see it as going head-to-head. Shrek 2 is a lighthearted co-op game you can pick up with friends and family, and plenty of players will happily play both. The holidays are when people are gathered around the couch or getting online together, so for a game like this, November is the right moment, not one to avoid. As for the short window between announcement and launch, we wanted to announce when the game was ready, so we didn’t have to keep fans waiting.”
In other news, Take-Two recently spoke about releasing GTA 6 right near Zelda: Ocarina of Time . CEO Strauss Zelnick said Nintendo’s game is “terrific, and they should be very proud of the title.”
Shrek 2 Remastered is available on Nintendo Switch 2 and Switch now.

One week from launch, GTA 6's physical map reportedly leaks online thanks to the £350 collector's edition on show in a UK department store
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's map has been subject to previous leaks, and was included in unofficial details revealed by the CyberLeek group earlier this year.
articles.txt:
With less than a week to go before GTA 6's hugely anticipated release , the game's final map - or at least a stylised poster version of it, depicting the state of Leonida's key landmarks - has surfaced online. It was reportedly snapped during Selfridge's sizable GTA 6 's takeover, and is seemingly the physical map included in Rockstar's £350 collector's edition.
Fans have been pondering GTA 6's map for some time now, cross-referencing previous map leaks with official trailer footage in an attempt to gain some insight into the major landmarks and regions Rockstar has in store. And while the newly leaked map is far from granular, it does at least appear to confirm Leonida's rough layout and the key locations players can visit this time.
Assuming the map's veracity, it's all rendered in an art style somewhere between mid-century tourism poster and Adult Swim, featuring the phrase "The Goodtime State" up top - a riff on the actual Florida's nickname, The Sunshine State - while Leonida's most notable points of interest are interspersed with cartoon figures.
There's a toking turtle (or possibly a tortoise - I'm no expert), a golfer proudly wearing assless chaps, a flying saucer, and more. I'll spare you the geographic details confirmed on the map in case you want to go in unspoiled. One point of amusement though: the way the map photo is cropped means fans searching for confirmation of an in-game Key West are still none the wiser.
It's not entirely clear where the wonkily angled photo originated from, but prominent Rockstar Games community insider Videotech, who shared the image on social media , suggested it came from a "naughty Selfridges employee" during Selfridges' GTA 6 takeover . The map itself appears to be the "double-Sided souvenir poster with map of Leonida" included in Rockstar's eyewateringly expensive GTA 6 Collector's Edition . This costs £350 and doesn't come with a copy of the game. Or assless chaps, for that matter.
This isn't the first time GTA 6's map - officially said to be twice the size of GTA 5's - has leaked online, although previous leaks have been notably more controversial. Earlier this year, a group calling itself CyberLeek shared unofficial gameplay and map details in the name of what it called "Gamers' Rights". In August, with Netflix's official GTA 6 unveiling looming, the group cashed out nearly £200,000 from its crypto scheme .
Amid all this, Rockstar has been embroiled in legal action after it was accused of union busting following the firing of over 30 employees . The case's conclusion has been delayed until next week , meaning a verdict could arrive just as GTA 6 goes on sale.

articles.chapeau: Au 12 novembre, les joueurs avaient précommandé environ 11,27 millions d’exemplaires numériques de GTA 6, pour un montant total d’environ $1,09 milliards, remboursements compris.
articles.txt:
MobiDevices.com Actualités GTA 6 a rapporté $1 milliard avant même sa sortie 13.11.2026 à 17:31 GTA 6 a rapporté $1 milliard avant même sa sortie Alexander Lazarchuk 2 min Audio 1 Suivre MobiDevices Ajoutez sur Google Source préférée Au 12 novembre, les joueurs avaient précommandé environ 11,27 millions d’exemplaires numériques de GTA 6, pour un montant total d’environ $1,09 milliards, remboursements compris.
Selon les estimations de Sensor Tower, au 12 novembre, les joueurs avaient passé environ 11,27 millions de précommandes numériques, pour un montant de $1,09 milliards, remboursements déduits. Au cours des deux derniers jours, le nombre de commandes a augmenté de 1,58 million et leur montant, d’environ $150 millions.
Du 10 au 12 novembre, le nombre de précommandes sur PS5 est passé de 7,23 à 8,46 millions, et sur Xbox Series X|S, de 2,46 à 2,81 millions. La console de Sony a ainsi représenté environ 78 % de la hausse enregistrée au cours de ces deux jours. Au 12 novembre, le montant des précommandes atteignait environ $821 millions sur PS5 et $272 millions sur Xbox.
En septembre 2013, les ventes physiques de GTA 5 ont dépassé $1 milliard au cours des trois premiers jours suivant sa sortie. Selon les estimations de Sensor Tower, GTA 6 a franchi le même seuil environ une semaine avant sa sortie, prévue le 19 novembre. Seules les précommandes numériques ont été prises en compte.
Selon les prévisions de juillet de Newzoo, les ventes mondiales cumulées de GTA 6 pourraient atteindre entre $3,3 et $5,2 milliards à la fin de la première semaine suivant sa sortie, précommandes comprises. Rockstar Games et Take-Two n’ont pas encore révélé leur nombre exact.

GTA 6 : la mise à jour 1.002.000 est obligatoire pour jouer, voici ce qu'elle contient
articles.txt:
À quelques jours de la sortie très attendue de Grand Theft Auto VI , Rockstar Games vient de publier la première mise à jour officielle du jeu. L’update 1.002.000 , d’un poids d’environ 1 Go , est en cours de déploiement sur PS5 et Xbox Series X . Son caractère obligatoire signifie que tous les joueurs devront l’installer avant de pouvoir lancer le jeu, une information cruciale pour ceux qui comptent se plonger dans l’aventure dès le 19 novembre.
L’arrivée de cette mise à jour intervient dans un contexte particulier : quelques jours plus tôt, une fuite a révélé en avance la carte du mode en ligne de GTA 6 . Rockstar n’a pas communiqué officiellement sur le contenu de cette patch, mais son caractère obligatoire indique qu’elle est essentielle au bon fonctionnement du jeu. Les joueurs qui préchargent le titre ou qui l’achèteront en version physique devront donc s’assurer de disposer d’une connexion internet pour télécharger cette mise à jour avant de pouvoir jouer.
Le poids de l’update, environ 1 Go, est relativement modeste comparé à la taille totale du jeu, qui devrait dépasser les 100 Go. Cela suggère que la mise à jour apporte des correctifs ciblés plutôt que des ajouts massifs de contenu. Néanmoins, l’absence de notes de patch officielles laisse planer le mystère sur les changements précis apportés par Rockstar.
Des analyses techniques menées par des dataminers, notamment le site iGrandTheftAuto, ont permis d’identifier les fichiers modifiés par cette mise à jour. Les changements concernent principalement deux aspects du jeu :
En revanche, les bases de données liées à l’audio, aux cinématiques et aux textures restent inchangées. Ces ajustements pourraient concerner des corrections de bugs, des optimisations de performances ou des ajustements de gameplay, mais sans confirmation officielle, il est impossible de déterminer leur nature exacte.
Autre particularité de cette mise à jour : sa distribution n’est pas simultanée pour tous les joueurs. Actuellement, seulement 50 % des utilisateurs ont accès à l’update 1.002.000. La seconde moitié devrait la recevoir dans les heures qui suivent, avec un décalage d’environ 11 heures . Cette approche progressive, souvent utilisée pour éviter de surcharger les serveurs, est relativement rare pour une mise à jour obligatoire avant le lancement d’un jeu majeur. Elle pourrait indiquer que Rockstar teste la stabilité de la patch sur un échantillon de joueurs avant de la généraliser.
Avec le lancement officiel prévu le 19 novembre , il est probable que Rockstar Games publie d’autres correctifs d’ici là. Une patch day-one est notamment attendue, comme c’est souvent le cas pour les jeux AAA. Cette première mise à jour pourrait donc n’être que la première d’une série visant à peaufiner l’expérience de jeu avant et après la sortie. Les joueurs sont invités à rester attentifs aux communications officielles de Rockstar pour connaître les prochaines étapes.
Pour rappel, Grand Theft Auto VI sera disponible le 19 novembre sur PS5 , Xbox Series X et Xbox Series S . Il sera également jouable sur Xbox One via le cloud gaming. Cette sortie est l’une des plus attendues de l’histoire du jeu vidéo, et chaque information la concernant est scrutée par des millions de joueurs à travers le monde.

articles.txt:
Depuis la première bande-annonce en 2023 du jeu vidéo très attendu GTA 6, l’actrice américaine Manni Perez est traquée et harcelée par des milliers de fans persuadés qu’elle se cache derrière le personnage principal féminin, Lucia Caminos.
Au début, c’est une histoire qui commence bien. Le 5 décembre 2023, après des années d’attente dans le silence, les fans de la série de jeux vidéo « Grand Theft Auto » voient enfin les premières images du jeu considéré comme le plus attendu au monde, « GTA 6 ».
Dans ces images, on fait la connaissance des deux protagonistes du jeu, Jason Duval et Lucia Caminos . Le premier visage montré dans ce trailer est d’ailleurs celui de Lucia, tout premier personnage féminin de la saga.
Celle-ci est immédiatement appréciée, sa pertinence est louée, bref, le personnage est assez largement adopté.
Mais assez rapidement, afin d’en savoir davantage sur leur jeu vidéo préféré, certains fans se mettent en quête d’informations supplémentaires sur le jeu et les personnages, surtout sur Lucia. Ils trouvent alors Manni Perez, une actrice américaine dont les traits ressemblent fortement à ceux de Lucia Caminos .
Sur ses réseaux, ils repèrent des vidéos où elle s’entraîne à la salle de sport, fait de la boxe, voire tire à l’arme à feu. Ils scrutent sa musculature qui pourrait évoquer un tournage et un rôle qui comporte de l’action. Pour eux, pas de doute, c’est elle derrière le personnage de Lucia.
Vidéo GTA 6 : comment Rockstar a fait attendre le monde entier pendant 13 ans
Elle, de son côté, ne réagit pas. Dans une interview donnée à la web radio « Triple Threat FM Radio » en 2022 (avant donc toute cette histoire), Manni Perez explique être sur « un gros projet », mais ne « pas pouvoir en dire plus », avant d’invoquer des « NDA ».
« NDA », c’est pour « Non Disclosure Agreement », soit un accord de non-divulgation. Ce qui signifie que même si c’était vraiment elle derrière le personnage de Lucia, elle ne pourrait jamais en parler avant d’en avoir le droit.
Après la pluie de messages sous ses publications, elle passe son compte Instagram en privé, et pléthore d’autres comptes lui volant son identité sont créés. Certains publient des images d’elle modifiées ou générées par IA. Son compte finit même par être désactivé par Instagram, avant d’être réactivé à la fin de l’été.
Pour Jennifer Lufau, spécialiste des représentations dans les jeux vidéo, cet épisode montre aussi que c’est « particulièrement difficile pour les femmes », qui « prennent souvent beaucoup plus cher en incarnant ces rôles ».

articles.t: La fenêtre de sortie de GTA 6 Online aurait fuité
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 sortira la semaine prochaine, le 19 novembre, sur PS5 et Xbox Series X/S. Cependant, il semble que les fans devront attendre environ un an pour son mode multijoueur.
articles.txt:
Après des années d'attente, les joueurs pourront enfin se plonger dans GTA 6 la semaine prochaine, le 19 novembre. Rockstar a déjà révélé de nombreux détails sur ce prochain titre, qui s'annonce comme l'un des plus grands lancements de jeux vidéo de l'histoire. Toutefois, si les joueurs pourront profiter de la campagne solo dès le lancement, le jeu ne proposera pas de mode multijoueur à sa sortie. Mais il semblerait désormais que la fenêtre de sortie de GTA 6 Online ait fuité.
En août dernier, Jason Schreier, journaliste chez Bloomberg, affirmait que Take-Two et Rockstar ne prévoyaient pas de révéler de détails sur le nouveau GTA Online dans l'immédiat. Il a ensuite précisé que Strauss Zelnick, PDG de Take-Two, n'avait pas spécifiquement évoqué la date de lancement du mode multijoueur.
Fait intéressant, Bloomberg Originals vient de publier une nouvelle vidéo intitulée « Pourquoi GTA 6 a nécessité 13 ans et 1 milliard de dollars de développement », dans laquelle interviennent Schreier et d'autres journalistes de Bloomberg. Si la vidéo traite principalement du long développement du jeu, le narrateur avance une information intéressante concernant son mode multijoueur.
« Le jeu qui sortira en 2026 ne sera même pas dans sa forme définitive. Le véritable moteur sur le long terme arrivera un an plus tard avec le multijoueur », déclare le narrateur. Cela laisse entendre que GTA 6 Online pourrait sortir vers la fin de l'année 2027, soit environ un an après la sortie du jeu de base.
Toutefois, il est important de garder à l'esprit que Rockstar et Take-Two n'ont pas officiellement confirmé cette fenêtre de sortie. On ignore également si le narrateur a accidentellement mentionné un détail qui n'avait pas encore été annoncé ou s'il a simplement émis une hypothèse quant à l'arrivée du mode multijoueur.

articles.chapeau: GTA 6 will launch next week, on November 19, on the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. However, it seems fans will need to wait around a year for its multiplayer mode.
articles.txt:
After years of waiting, gamers will finally be able to dive into GTA 6 next week, on November 19. Rockstar has already revealed plenty of details about the upcoming title, which is shaping up to be one of the biggest video game launches in history. However, while players will be able to enjoy the single-player campaign at launch, the game won't arrive with a multiplayer mode. But now, it seems that the release window for GTA 6 Online may have leaked.
Back in August, Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier claimed that Take-Two and Rockstar weren't planning to reveal details about the new GTA Online anytime soon. He later clarified that Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick hadn't specifically discussed when the multiplayer mode would launch.
Interestingly, Bloomberg Originals has now published a new video titled "Why GTA 6 Took 13 Years and $1 Billion to Make," featuring Schreier and other Bloomberg reporters. While the video mainly discusses the game's lengthy development, the narrator makes an interesting claim about its multiplayer mode.
"The game that ships in 2026 is not even its final form. The real long-term engine arrives a year later with multiplayer," the narrator says. This suggests that GTA 6 Online could launch sometime in late 2027, roughly a year after the base game's release.
However, it's important to keep in mind that Rockstar and Take-Two haven't officially confirmed this release window. It's also unclear whether the narrator accidentally mentioned an unannounced detail or simply made an assumption about the multiplayer mode's arrival.

Follow on Google Discover The November 12 GTA 6 map leak gives players a clearer picture of Leonida's counties, smaller settlements and southern islands. Photos of a collector's poster show Southwind on Goose Key, Pelican Valley in the Grassrivers region and several northern place names. A wider photograph also reveals how Vice City connects to the countryside and western coast.
Some names, including Lummox County and Capri, appeared in earlier leaks or community mapping. The collector's poster adds physical evidence and a better sense of where these places sit. Players will get an official printable Leonida map for free on November 19, the day Grand Theft Auto VI launches.
On November 12, photos taken at Selfridges' Manchester Exchange Square store showed the Goodtime State – Vice City Collection and its folded map poster. A separate image of the poster opened out circulated later, exposing most of the illustrated state. The original store photos show readable labels, highway signs and parts of the southern island chain.
The poster places smaller locations within the six regions Rockstar has introduced: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park. Its county labels provide a useful frame for exploring the state beyond the main cities and beaches.
For GTA 6 fans, the November photographs offer two kinds of discoveries: names that are newly readable on the collector's poster, and places previously discussed through earlier images or unofficial mapping.

Pelican Valley offers a different starting point for exploration: a named destination in the wetlands, where waterways and land routes may shape how players move around.
Capri remains an intriguing location on the western side of Leonida. Fans have proposed that it could be a second substantial city. The poster establishes a useful geographic reference for the name; the scale of the settlement will become clearer in the game.

Vice City anchors the eastern coast, Port Gellhorn sits on the west, and Ambrosia occupies the interior near Lake Leonida. A coastal drive could link the urban districts with beach towns, while a trip west would lead toward Port Gellhorn's racetrack and older tourist areas. Players interested in water exploration will have the Keys and Grassrivers to investigate. The collector's artwork also shows toll markings, racing imagery near Port Gellhorn and golf references around Vice City.

These are broad developer comparisons; the published poster uses a playful tourist-map layout with enlarged icons and simplified roads.

articles.t: La carte complète de GTA 6 issue de l’édition collector a fuité, dévoilant de nouvelles zones de Leonida
articles.chapeau: La coûteuse édition collector de GTA 6 comprend une carte très convoitée de Leonida. Une fuite sur Instagram dévoile le déballage du coffret, montrant la quasi-totalité du poster. Cette fuite révèle de nouvelles zones du monde ouvert, du comté de Lummox au nord à Pelican Valley, dans le sud des Grassrivers.
articles.txt:
Grâce à une fuite sur Instagram, les fans disposent désormais de l’aperçu le plus complet à ce jour de la carte de GTA 6 . Le compte a déballé la coûteuse Vice City Collection , dévoilant le poster et les autres bonus. Malgré l’imminence de la date de sortie , certaines régions de Leonida restaient encore mystérieuses.
Dans un premier temps, une présentation du coffret collector dans un magasin Selfridges à Manchester avait révélé une partie du décor inspiré de la Floride. Le poster était plié, mais il fournissait tout de même des indices. Goose Key, dans la partie sud, figurait parmi les destinations qui n’avaient pas encore été annoncées. Tex2 a ensuite partagé le reel Instagram, supprimé depuis, qui dévoile davantage du plus grand monde ouvert de Rockstar à ce jour.
À l’exception de certaines zones en bordure de la carte de GTA 6 , comme Leonida Keys, la plupart des régions et des noms de lieux sont visibles. On y trouve notamment Lummox County au nord et des destinations telles que Moreau. Plus au sud, Pelican Valley, située dans Grassrivers, est une autre découverte.
La bande-annonce Netflix Extended Look laissait entendre que le jeu comporterait des péages. Cela semble se confirmer, puisque la carte imprimée mentionne des routes payantes. Son style cartoon comprend également une icône de dirigeable, un aéronef aperçu dans le ciel des États-Unis.
Les acheteurs qui précommandent doivent débourser 400 $ pour Goodtime State – Vice City Collection afin d’obtenir cette aide à la navigation. Les fans espéraient que les exemplaires physiques de GTA 6 sur Xbox et PS5 incluraient la carte. De précédents titres de Rockstar comme GTA 5 et Red Dead Redemption 2 avaient adopté cette approche.
Le studio mettra à disposition une carte numérique téléchargeable le jour de la sortie ou peu après. En revanche, les boîtes vendues dans le commerce contiennent bien un poster recto verso avec l’illustration de la jaquette et la Bikini Girl déjà aperçue.
Take-Two ou Rockstar ont peut-être récemment pris pour cible le GTA 6 Mapping Project . Cette initiative communautaire avait reconstitué une carte de Vice City et de Leonida à partir de captures d’écran et de bandes-annonces . Bien que son serveur Discord ait apparemment fait l’objet d’une notification pour violation du DMCA, le site web du projet reste accessible. Le projet cherchera de nouveaux indices dans la dernière fuite sur Instagram.

articles.t: Rockstar says GTA 6 PS5 Pro build ran at 60 fps with major performance compromises
articles.chapeau: Rockstar may have experimented with a higher framerate mode on the PS5 Pro. In a leaked interview, the studio explained that Leonida traffic and realistic NPCs proved obstacles. As with the Xbox Series X and base PS5, GTA 6 won’t exceed 30 fps on the enhanced PlayStation console.
articles.txt:
The recently revealed GTA 6 PS5 Pro specs disappointed owners of Sony’s flagship hardware. Targeting 30 fps, Rockstar prioritized visual fidelity even on the pricey PlayStation console . In a leaked interview, the studio says it tested a build that achieved 60 fps . However, most players wouldn’t accept the performance drawbacks.
Lance McDonald is a game researcher who often offers technical insight into trending topics. He noticed a Rockstar interview went live on TheGamer apparently ahead of schedule. Before the article vanished, McDonald captured a notable quote:
We had a build that ran at 60FPS on PS5 Pro, but in order to achieve this, we had to remove all of the cars and most of the heads.
While likely joking, it’s one of the few times a developer has addressed the system. Still, when the Netflix Extended Look trailer debuted, Rockstar North co-lead Rob Nelson hinted at GTA 6 PS5 Pro performance. He said 30 fps was the target for all consoles , though more optimization was possible on or after the release date.
Unfortunately, on November 10th, any hopes for a framerate boost faded. Just like with the Xbox Series X and base PS5, 30 fps is the goal for the mightiest PlayStation system. On the other hand, exclusive benefits include ray-traced shadows and PSSR 2 upscaling. Players should see improved lighting and even crisper graphics.
The news emerged after a metadata leak pointed to a 120Hz high framerate mode for the GTA 6 PS5 Pro upgrade. Lacking VRR, the combination typically results in a 40 fps option on enhanced games . That at least leaves the door open for a welcome post-launch performance update.
Rockstar humorously mentioned in the interview how the dense Leonida map challenges the most capable hardware. Vice City roadways are teeming with cars, while hyper-realistic NPCs pack sidewalks and beaches . The professional model boasts a superior GPU, but its CPU is comparable to the base console. As a result, it still faces limitations in these complex scenes.
Fans unhappy with the 30 fps visuals may need to wait for the inevitable GTA 6 PC port .

articles.t: GTA 6 Gameplay Clips Circulate 7 Days Before Launch [2026]
articles.chapeau: New GTA 6 gameplay clips circulate a week before the Nov. 19 launch. What Rockstar confirmed, what stays unverified, and what to expect.
articles.txt:
With seven days left on the calendar before Grand Theft Auto VI arrives on November 19, 2026, new GTA 6 gameplay clips are circulating online. Happy Gamer reports that the footage has spread across social platforms, and the item that drew the most attention came from an account called Only in Dade . It appears to show a drive along Ocean Drive. Rockstar Games reposted it to its Instagram story and liked the original post.
That repost is the whole story, and it is also where the confirmed facts stop. Rockstar has not issued a statement calling the clip a new gameplay release, and the footage is too unclear to settle who is behind the camera. Readers who followed the earlier GTA 6 build leak coverage will recognize the pattern: a lot of noise, a small core of verified information, and a launch date that does not move.
This analysis separates what is confirmed from what is circulating. It covers what Rockstar has officially put out, what the Ocean Drive clip does and does not show, how the launch is structured on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and what the final week probably looks like for players, retailers, and anyone chasing a click. Every specific claim below traces to the named outlets or to Rockstar’s own pages. Where the record is silent, the article says so.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The sequence is simple. Footage appeared online that viewers took to be new Grand Theft Auto VI material. Happy Gamer framed it as the top gaming story of the moment and tied it to the approaching launch. The most specific item came from Only in Dade , which posted what looks like a drive along Ocean Drive. Rockstar Games then reposted that video to its Instagram story and liked the post.
Those two actions from the publisher’s own account are the strongest signal in the record. A repost to a brand’s story is a deliberate act, and a like is a lighter but still visible one. Neither is a press release. Fans read them as a wink. A careful reporter reads them as a data point that is consistent with the footage being genuine, but not as proof of anything specific about how it was made or where it came from.
The word clips, plural, also deserves a pause. The record names one clip with enough detail to describe. Reports of additional clips exist in the general conversation, but no other single video carries the same documented chain of a named poster plus a Rockstar reaction. This article treats the Ocean Drive video as the anchor and everything else as unverified chatter.
Start with the solid ground. Rockstar Games is the developer and publisher named in official materials, and the release date is November 19, 2026. The platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Both PlayStation and Xbox list the launch at midnight local time on November 19, which means players in different time zones will get the game at different real-world moments as midnight rolls across the globe.
Digital pre-load is also confirmed. It opened on November 10, 2026. On PlayStation 5 it started at midnight local time, and on Xbox Series X|S it started globally at 12:00 a.m. GMT. That detail matters for this story because pre-load is the stage where a lot of players first touch the game’s files, and where a lot of leak chatter tends to multiply.
On the footage side, Rockstar’s PlayStation page says An Extended Look was captured entirely from in-game footage on PlayStation 5. That is the official benchmark for how the publisher wants the game to look in motion. Any circulating clip gets measured against it. The record includes no confirmed price, no confirmed technical specifications, and no on-record quote from a named speaker, so this piece leaves all three out rather than guess.
The clip is short on provenance and long on speculation. Only in Dade posted video that appears to show a drive along Ocean Drive. The wording from the reporting is careful: it appears to show that. Nobody in the cited record claims to have authenticated the video frame by frame, and the footage was described as too unclear to establish finer details.
Poor clarity cuts two ways. It makes the clip easy to dismiss, since low-quality footage is a hallmark of both real leaks and quick fakes. It also makes the clip easy to over-read, because viewers fill in blanks with what they hope to see. A blurry car, a bright street, and a camera that moves like someone filming

articles.t: YouTube to host 24-hour GTA 6 release date livestream with launch day gameplay
articles.chapeau: On the GTA 6 release date, gamers unable to play the Rockstar title can watch a 24-hour YouTube livestream. The video-sharing platform has enlisted content creators to showcase single-player gameplay. In the long run, the anticipated online mode may attract even more viewership.
articles.txt:
The GTA 6 release date should give streaming platforms a massive boost. To celebrate, YouTube has organized a 24-hour livestream dedicated to the launch . Starting at midnight EST on November 19th, audiences will see around 30 content creators explore the Leonida map for the first time.
For fans in many parts of the world, the Rockstar title unlocks even before the YouTube event kicks off. New Zealanders with GTA 6 preloads can access the game at midnight local time, which is 6 AM EST on November 18th. In Germany and other parts of Europe, the show airs 6 hours after some fans begin playing.
To prepare viewers for the 24-hour stream, the RDCWorld collective will host a pre-show at 11 PM EST. Besides gameplay , there will also be live reporting in Miami , where a massive marketing campaign is underway. Expected content creators include Jake Baldino, Cinna, Jelly, Rivers, Caylus, and Zhong.
In a blog post , YouTube highlighted how the Grand Theft Auto franchise has already generated over 900 billion views. Leading up to the GTA 6 release date, the company estimates that videos for the latest Rockstar project have produced over 40 billion views. That number is poised to grow once the game unlocks, but many broadcasters are looking more forward to a GTA Online sequel.
Twitch CEO Dan Clancy hinted an online mode would be ready in 2027. If the GTA 5 pattern repeats, possible role-playing content will prove the most popular. A Hatchet study found that over half of views in 2026 were for this creative spin on multiplayer.
Fortunately for streamers, single-player gameplay should keep fans occupied for weeks, if not months. The map of Vice City and surrounding regions is considerably larger than the previous Grand Theft Auto . Rockstar North ’s Rob Nelson said the Jason and Lucia campaign , plus optional objectives, took him roughly 80 hours to complete.
YouTube competitor Kick also plans to capitalize on the launch. The site is giving away 10,000 digital copies of GTA 6 Ultimate Edition to supporters. Account holders who watch at least 3 hours of livestreams can qualify for a chance to win.
